items.title: IaaS
items.body: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) menyewakan infrastruktur: VM (Virtual Machine), jaringan, dan storage. Contohnya Azure Virtual Machines. Microsoft mengurus infrastruktur fisiknya. Kamu mengurus sistem operasi di VM, aplikasi, dan konfigurasinya, termasuk firewall di VM. Dari semua jenis layanan cloud, IaaS memberi kontrol paling besar.
keyPoints: Contoh IaaS: Azure Virtual Machines
Microsoft: fisik. Kamu: sistem operasi ke atas
Kontrol paling besar, kerja juga paling banyak

items.prompt: In IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), you are responsible for installing and patching the operating system.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini benar. Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), semua dari OS (Operating System) ke atas adalah urusanmu. Microsoft mengurus hardware fisik.

items.prompt: Which Azure service is an example of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service)?
items.explanation: VM (Virtual Machine) adalah contoh klasik IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): kamu dapat mesin virtual dan mengatur sistem operasinya sendiri. Microsoft 365 itu SaaS (Software as a Service). Azure Policy memeriksa aturan dan Pricing Calculator memperkirakan biaya; keduanya tidak menjalankan workload.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence.
items.sentence: In IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), Microsoft manages the physical ___, and you manage the ___ system and everything above it.
items.explanation: Garis batas IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): hardware fisik milik Microsoft, sistem operasi ke atas milikmu.

items.title: Siapa yang mem-patch VM?
items.body: Karena sistem operasi di VM (Virtual Machine) adalah urusanmu, memasang update dan patch-nya juga tugasmu. Azure Update Manager membantu memantau dan menjadwalkan update untuk banyak VM. Tapi alat itu tetap kamu yang mengatur; Microsoft tidak mem-patch VM milikmu tanpa diminta.
keyPoints: Patch sistem operasi di VM = tugas customer
Azure Update Manager membantu menjadwalkan update
items.trap: Patching otomatis oleh penyedia hanya berlaku di PaaS (Platform as a Service) dan SaaS (Software as a Service), bukan untuk VM di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).

items.prompt: Sort each task by who does it in IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).
items.explanation: Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), Microsoft mengurus fisiknya. Mulai dari OS (Operating System) ke atas, termasuk aplikasi dan firewall di VM (Virtual Machine), adalah urusanmu.

items.prompt: Who should install the updates?

scene.title: Security updates missing
scene.message: Your Azure virtual machine is missing critical Windows updates.

options: The customer, on the virtual machine
Microsoft, because it patches every customer virtual machine automatically
Nobody, because virtual machines never need updates
The customer, by resizing the virtual machine to a bigger size
items.explanation: Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), OS (Operating System) di dalam VM (Virtual Machine) adalah tanggung jawabmu, termasuk patch. Azure punya alat bantu seperti Azure Update Manager, tapi kamu yang mengaturnya.

items.title: Lift-and-shift
items.body: Lift-and-shift (rehost) memindahkan server on-premises ke Azure apa adanya, biasanya ke VM (Virtual Machine), tanpa mengubah kodenya. Caranya cepat dan risikonya rendah. Kalau aplikasinya ditulis ulang supaya memakai layanan cloud, itu modernisasi, bukan lift-and-shift. IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) cocok untuk lift-and-shift, dan juga untuk lingkungan test dan development yang butuh kontrol penuh.
keyPoints: Lift-and-shift = pindah apa adanya, tanpa ubah kode
Menulis ulang aplikasi = modernisasi
Kegunaan IaaS: lift-and-shift, test, dan development

items.prompt: A lift-and-shift migration usually means rewriting an application before moving it to the cloud.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Lift-and-shift justru memindahkan apa adanya, biasanya ke VM (Virtual Machine). Menulis ulang aplikasi itu modernisasi.

items.prompt: A company must move 50 on-premises servers to Azure within one month, and it cannot change the applications. Which approach fits best?
options: Lift-and-shift the servers to Azure virtual machines
Rewrite every app before moving it to the cloud
Replace every app with SaaS (Software as a Service) products
Keep the servers on-premises and buy more hardware
items.explanation: Waktu singkat dan aplikasi tidak boleh diubah: lift-and-shift ke VM (Virtual Machine) adalah jalan tercepat.

items.prompt: Which two scenarios are a good fit for IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service)? Choose two.
options: Test and development environments that need full control
Migrating existing servers with minimal changes
Deploying web code without managing the operating system
items.explanation: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) cocok untuk test/dev dan lift-and-shift. Email jadi itu SaaS (Software as a Service), sedangkan deploy kode tanpa mengurus OS (Operating System) itu PaaS (Platform as a Service).

items.title: PaaS
items.body: PaaS (Platform as a Service) menyediakan platform siap pakai untuk menjalankan aplikasi. Penyedia mengurus hardware, sistem operasi, dan runtime. Kamu fokus ke kode aplikasi dan data. Contohnya Azure App Service untuk menjalankan web app dan API (Application Programming Interface).
keyPoints: Contoh PaaS: Azure App Service
Penyedia: hardware, sistem operasi, runtime
Kamu: kode dan data

items.prompt: In PaaS (Platform as a Service), you manage the operating system that runs your application.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), OS (Operating System) dan platform diurus penyedia. Kamu fokus ke aplikasi dan data.

items.prompt: Which Azure service is an example of PaaS (Platform as a Service)?
items.explanation: App Service menjalankan web app tanpa kamu mengurus server atau OS (Operating System). Itu PaaS (Platform as a Service).

items.prompt: A development team wants to deploy a web app quickly without managing servers, operating systems, or patching. Which service type fits best?
items.explanation: Tanpa urus server dan patching, tapi tetap menulis kode sendiri: itu PaaS (Platform as a Service).

items.prompt: Complete the sentence.
items.sentence: With PaaS (Platform as a Service), the provider manages the operating ___ and runtime, so developers can focus on ___ and data.
items.explanation: PaaS (Platform as a Service) = platform diurus penyedia, kamu fokus ke kode dan data.

items.title: Yang diurus Azure di App Service
items.body: Di Azure App Service, Azure mem-patch sistem operasi dan runtime secara otomatis. App Service juga punya fitur bawaan seperti autoscale dan integrasi dengan alat developer untuk deployment. Yang tetap jadi tanggung jawabmu: kode aplikasi, data, dan akun pengguna.
keyPoints: Patch sistem operasi dan runtime: otomatis oleh Azure
Bawaan: autoscale dan alat developer
Tetap tugasmu: kode, data, akun pengguna
items.trap: Kalau web app di App Service error karena kode barumu, itu tetap tugas timmu, bukan Microsoft.

items.prompt: Sort by who manages it in PaaS (Platform as a Service).
items.explanation: Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), penyedia mengurus fisik, OS (Operating System), dan runtime. Kode, data, dan akun tetap milikmu.

items.prompt: Which two are advantages of PaaS (Platform as a Service) for developers? Choose two.
options: No operating system patching to manage
Full control of the operating system
items.explanation: PaaS (Platform as a Service) melepas beban OS (Operating System) dan menyediakan scaling serta alat developer. Kontrol penuh atas OS itu ciri IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A team moves its web app from an Azure virtual machine to Azure App Service.

statements.text: The team no longer needs to patch the web server's operating system.
The team is still responsible for its application data.
The team can now sign in to the physical servers.

items.explanation: Pindah ke PaaS (Platform as a Service) melepas urusan OS (Operating System), tapi data tetap milikmu. Server fisik tidak pernah bisa kamu akses.

items.prompt: Who should fix it?

scene.title: Web app returns errors
scene.message: Your web app on Azure App Service returns errors after the team's latest code change.

options: The development team, because the application code is the customer's responsibility
Microsoft, because App Service is PaaS (Platform as a Service)
Nobody; wait for Azure to restart the region
items.explanation: Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), platform diurus Microsoft, tapi kode aplikasimu tetap tanggung jawabmu.

items.title: SaaS
items.body: SaaS (Software as a Service) adalah aplikasi jadi yang tinggal dipakai lewat internet, misalnya Microsoft 365 untuk email dan dokumen. Penyedia mengurus infrastruktur, server, dan update aplikasinya. Tapi data, device, serta account dan identity tetap tanggung jawabmu.
keyPoints: Contoh SaaS: Microsoft 365
Penyedia: server dan update aplikasi
Tetap tugasmu: data, device, account dan identity

items.prompt: Microsoft 365 is an example of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Microsoft 365 adalah aplikasi jadi yang tinggal dipakai, jadi termasuk SaaS (Software as a Service), bukan IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).

items.prompt: In SaaS (Software as a Service), which item is still the customer's responsibility?
items.explanation: Bahkan di SaaS (Software as a Service), akun dan data tetap urusanmu. Sisanya diurus penyedia.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso uses a SaaS (Software as a Service) customer relationship app.

statements.text: Contoso must install updates to the app.
Contoso is responsible for who has access to its data in the app.
Contoso must buy the servers that run the app.

items.explanation: Di SaaS (Software as a Service), update dan server diurus penyedia, dan kamu biasanya cukup membayar langganan. Akses ke data tetap tanggung jawabmu.

items.prompt: Which two responsibilities stay with the customer when using SaaS (Software as a Service)? Choose two.
items.explanation: Account dan identity serta data selalu milik customer, di semua jenis layanan.

items.title: Membandingkan jenis layanan
items.body: Makin ke kanan, makin sedikit yang kamu urus. Di on-premises, semuanya urusanmu. Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), kamu mengurus sistem operasi ke atas. Di PaaS (Platform as a Service), kamu mengurus kode dan data. Di SaaS (Software as a Service), kamu tinggal memakai aplikasinya.
keyPoints: Urutan tanggung jawab: on-premises > IaaS > PaaS > SaaS
Data dan akun selalu milikmu di semua jenis

items.prompt: A small business wants email and document sharing for 20 staff. It doesn't want to install or maintain any software. Which service type fits best?
items.explanation: Tidak mau install dan merawat apa pun, cukup pakai: itu SaaS (Software as a Service), misalnya Microsoft 365.

items.prompt: Match each service type with an example.
items.explanation: VM (Virtual Machine) = IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), App Service = PaaS (Platform as a Service), Microsoft 365 = SaaS (Software as a Service).

items.prompt: Sort each scenario by service type.

items.text: Rent a virtual machine and install your own database
Move existing servers as they are
Deploy code to a managed web platform
Build apps without patching the operating system
Use a finished email service in the browser

items.explanation: Kontrol penuh atas mesin = IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service). Platform siap pakai untuk kodemu = PaaS (Platform as a Service). Aplikasi jadi = SaaS (Software as a Service).

items.prompt: Order the models from the most customer responsibility to the least.
items.explanation: On-premises: semua urusanmu. IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service): dari OS (Operating System) ke atas. PaaS (Platform as a Service): aplikasi dan data. SaaS (Software as a Service): paling sedikit, tinggal pakai.

items.title: Serverless
items.body: Serverless berarti kamu tidak mengelola server sama sekali. Kamu cukup menulis kode, dan penyedia yang menjalankan serta menskalakannya. Kode berjalan saat dipicu event, misalnya request HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol), file baru, atau timer. Di Azure, contohnya Azure Functions, yang Microsoft golongkan sebagai PaaS (Platform as a Service).
keyPoints: Tidak ada server yang kamu kelola
Kode berjalan saat ada event
Azure Functions: serverless, termasuk PaaS
items.trap: Serverless bukan jenis layanan keempat di samping IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), PaaS, dan SaaS (Software as a Service). Di kisi-kisi AZ-900, serverless ada di bagian cloud computing, sedangkan jenis layanan cloud hanya IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS.

items.prompt: In serverless computing, you still have to manage and patch the servers that run your code.
items.explanation: Pernyataan ini salah. Server tetap ada, tapi sepenuhnya diurus penyedia. Kamu cukup fokus ke kode.

items.prompt: Which Azure service is a common example of serverless computing?
items.explanation: Azure Functions menjalankan kode saat ada event tanpa kamu mengelola server. Itu contoh serverless. VM (Virtual Machine) itu IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), App Service itu PaaS (Platform as a Service), dan Microsoft 365 itu SaaS (Software as a Service).

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A developer builds an Azure Functions app that runs when a new order arrives.

statements.text: The function runs all the time, even when no orders arrive.
The developer must create virtual machines to host the function.
If no orders arrive, the function doesn't run.

items.explanation: Function dipicu event (pesanan baru), jadi kalau tidak ada event, kode tidak berjalan. Tidak perlu VM (Virtual Machine).

items.title: Bayar saat kode berjalan
items.body: Di plan serverless Azure Functions, yaitu Flex Consumption (pengganti Consumption plan versi lama), kamu hanya membayar saat function berjalan. Tagihannya dihitung dari jumlah eksekusi dan memori yang dipakai selama kode berjalan. Azure juga menambah dan mengurangi instance otomatis mengikuti jumlah event. Kalau tidak ada event, kode tidak berjalan.
keyPoints: Bayar per eksekusi, bukan per jam server menyala
Scaling otomatis mengikuti jumlah event
items.example: Upload foto jarang terjadi. Function pengubah ukuran gambar hanya berjalan, dan ditagih, saat ada upload.

items.prompt: A company needs to resize images whenever a user uploads a photo. Uploads are rare and unpredictable. Which option keeps costs lowest?
options: Run the code as a serverless function triggered by each upload
Run the code on a virtual machine that stays on 24 hours a day
Buy a dedicated physical server for the resize code
Run the code on two virtual machines behind a load balancer
items.explanation: Kalau event jarang, serverless paling hemat: kode hanya berjalan (dan ditagih) saat ada upload.

items.prompt: Which two are characteristics of serverless computing? Choose two.
options: You are billed only when your code runs
You choose and patch the operating system
You must reserve servers in advance
items.explanation: Serverless = scale otomatis dan bayar saat kode berjalan (misalnya Flex Consumption plan di Azure Functions). Tidak ada OS (Operating System) yang kamu urus.

items.prompt: Complete the sentence.
items.sentence: Serverless code runs when an ___ happens, and you pay only while the code is ___.
items.explanation: Serverless = dipicu event, bayar saat berjalan.

items.title: Serverless atau VM?
items.body: Serverless cocok untuk kode kecil yang dipicu event, misalnya memproses file yang baru di-upload atau tugas terjadwal dengan timer. Aplikasi yang butuh kontrol penuh atas sistem operasi lebih cocok di VM (Virtual Machine). Satu catatan: dalam shared responsibility model, Microsoft menggolongkan Azure Functions sebagai PaaS (Platform as a Service).
keyPoints: Event dan tugas terjadwal: serverless
Butuh kontrol sistem operasi: VM

items.prompt: Sort each workload.

items.text: Run code when a file is uploaded
Send a reminder on a timer every morning
Legacy app that needs a custom operating system setup
Software that needs full control of the server

items.explanation: Kode kecil yang dipicu event cocok untuk serverless. Aplikasi yang butuh kontrol penuh atas OS (Operating System) cocok untuk VM (Virtual Machine).

items.prompt: Match each Azure service with its description.
pairs: Runs code on events, and you pay per execution
Managed platform for your web apps
Finished software that you just use
items.explanation: Azure Functions adalah layanan serverless yang Microsoft golongkan sebagai PaaS (Platform as a Service). Azure Virtual Machines adalah IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), App Service adalah PaaS, dan Microsoft 365 adalah SaaS (Software as a Service).

items.prompt: A company runs its app on Azure virtual machines. A security update for the operating system of the virtual machines is released. Who must make sure the update is installed?
options: The company, for example by scheduling it with Azure Update Manager
Microsoft, because Azure patches the operating system of every customer virtual machine
Nobody, because Azure virtual machines never need operating system updates
The internet service provider that connects the company to Azure
items.explanation: Di IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), memasang update sistem operasi VM (Virtual Machine) adalah tugas customer. Azure Update Manager membantu memantau dan menjadwalkan update, tapi customer yang mengaturnya.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: A company plans to rent Azure virtual machines and install its own database software on them.

statements.text: This is an example of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service).
The company configures the firewall inside the virtual machines.
Microsoft installs and configures the database software for the company.

items.explanation: Menyewa VM (Virtual Machine) adalah IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service). Customer mengurus sistem operasi, aplikasi, dan konfigurasinya, termasuk firewall di dalam VM. Software yang dipasang customer juga diurus customer.

items.prompt: A company wants to host an API (Application Programming Interface) without managing the operating system or the runtime. It also wants built-in autoscale. Which Azure service should the company use?
items.explanation: Azure App Service adalah PaaS (Platform as a Service): Azure mengurus hardware, sistem operasi, dan runtime, dan ada fitur bawaan seperti autoscale. Di VM (IaaS), sistem operasi diurus customer. Microsoft 365 adalah SaaS (Software as a Service).

items.prompt: A company runs an Azure Functions app on the Flex Consumption plan to process orders. How is the company billed for the compute that runs the function code?
options: A fixed monthly fee for a dedicated server
For every hour of the day, even when no orders arrive
For the executions and the memory used while the code runs
For the virtual machines that the company creates to host the function
items.explanation: Di plan serverless Azure Functions (Flex Consumption dan Consumption), customer membayar saat function berjalan: jumlah eksekusi dan memori yang dipakai. Customer tidak membuat VM (Virtual Machine) sendiri.

items.prompt: A company starts using a SaaS (Software as a Service) app to track customer support tickets. Which task is still the company's responsibility?
options: Installing new versions of the ticket app when they are released
Deciding which employees can access the ticket data
Maintaining the servers that run the ticket app
Patching the operating system of the servers that run the app
items.explanation: Di SaaS (Software as a Service), penyedia mengurus infrastruktur, server, dan update aplikasinya. Data, akun, dan siapa yang boleh mengakses data tetap tanggung jawab customer.

items.prompt: A company needs to send a reminder email every morning at 8:00. The company does not want to manage any servers. What should the company use?
options: A virtual machine that runs all day
An on-premises server with a scheduled task
Azure Functions with a timer trigger
items.explanation: Azure Functions menjalankan kode yang dipicu event, termasuk timer, tanpa server yang harus dikelola customer. VM (Virtual Machine) dan server on-premises harus dikelola sendiri.

items.prompt: For each statement, select Yes or No.
items.scenario: Contoso plans to process uploaded files with Azure Functions. The number of uploads changes a lot during the day.

statements.text: Azure Functions adds instances automatically when many files arrive.
Contoso must patch the operating system that runs the functions.
In the shared responsibility model, Microsoft classifies Azure Functions as PaaS (Platform as a Service).

items.explanation: Azure Functions menambah dan mengurangi instance mengikuti jumlah event. Serverless berarti customer tidak mengelola server. Microsoft menggolongkan Azure Functions sebagai PaaS (Platform as a Service).

items.prompt: The developers at a company need test environments where they control the operating system and can rebuild an environment quickly. Which cloud service type fits best?
options: PaaS (Platform as a Service), because the provider manages the operating system
items.explanation: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) cocok untuk lingkungan test dan development yang butuh kontrol penuh dan cepat dibuat ulang. Di PaaS (Platform as a Service) dan SaaS (Software as a Service), sistem operasi diurus penyedia, jadi developer tidak bisa mengaturnya.

items.prompt: A company has a legacy app that needs a custom operating system configuration and runs all the time. Which compute option fits best?
options: A SaaS (Software as a Service) app
items.explanation: VM (IaaS) memberi kontrol penuh atas sistem operasi. Azure Functions menjalankan kode saat ada event dan tidak memberi akses ke pengaturan sistem operasi. Microsoft 365 adalah aplikasi jadi.

items.prompt: A company must move its servers to Azure quickly, with low risk, and without changing the application code. Which two statements are true? Choose two.
options: Lift-and-shift to Azure virtual machines fits this requirement
Rewriting the apps to use cloud services is a modernization strategy, not lift-and-shift
Lift-and-shift means rewriting every app before it moves
Only SaaS (Software as a Service) products can be moved quickly
items.explanation: Lift-and-shift (rehost) memindahkan workload ke Azure VM (Virtual Machine) tanpa mengubah kodenya, cepat dan berisiko rendah. Menulis ulang aplikasi termasuk modernisasi.

items.prompt: A company is choosing where to run four projects. Match each project with the option it describes.
pairs: Rent a virtual machine and install your own software
Deploy code to a managed web platform
Keep the app on servers in the company's own building
items.explanation: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) menyewakan infrastruktur seperti VM (Virtual Machine), PaaS (Platform as a Service) menyediakan platform siap pakai untuk kode, SaaS (Software as a Service) adalah aplikasi jadi, dan on-premises berarti server sendiri di gedung sendiri. Layanan serverless seperti Azure Functions juga termasuk PaaS, bukan jenis keempat.

items.prompt: A company compares on-premises servers, IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), PaaS (Platform as a Service), and SaaS (Software as a Service). The company wants the smallest share of management responsibility. Which option should it choose?
items.explanation: Tanggung jawab customer paling besar di on-premises, lalu IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), lalu PaaS (Platform as a Service), dan paling kecil di SaaS (Software as a Service).

facts.statement: IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service) menyewakan infrastruktur seperti virtual machine, jaringan, dan storage, dan memberi customer kontrol paling besar di antara jenis layanan cloud.
Azure Virtual Machines adalah contoh IaaS.
Di IaaS, Microsoft mengurus infrastruktur fisik; customer mengurus sistem operasi di virtual machine, aplikasi, dan konfigurasinya, termasuk firewall di virtual machine.
Di IaaS, memasang update dan patch sistem operasi virtual machine adalah tugas customer.
Azure Update Manager membantu customer memantau dan menjadwalkan update untuk virtual machine, tapi customer yang mengaturnya.
Lift-and-shift (rehost) memindahkan workload ke Azure tanpa mengubah kodenya, misalnya dari server on-premises ke Azure virtual machine; caranya cepat dan risikonya rendah.
Menulis ulang atau mengubah aplikasi supaya memakai layanan cloud termasuk strategi modernisasi, bukan lift-and-shift.
IaaS cocok untuk lingkungan test dan development yang butuh kontrol penuh dan cepat dibuat ulang, serta untuk memindahkan server yang ada dengan perubahan minimal.

PaaS (Platform as a Service) menyediakan platform siap pakai untuk menjalankan aplikasi: penyedia mengurus hardware, sistem operasi, dan runtime, sedangkan customer mengurus kode aplikasi dan datanya.
Azure App Service adalah contoh PaaS untuk menjalankan web app dan API.
Di Azure App Service, Azure mem-patch sistem operasi dan runtime secara otomatis.
Azure App Service menyediakan fitur bawaan seperti autoscale dan integrasi dengan alat developer untuk deployment.
Di PaaS, kode aplikasi, data, dan akun pengguna tetap tanggung jawab customer.
SaaS (Software as a Service) adalah aplikasi jadi yang tinggal dipakai lewat internet, misalnya Microsoft 365 untuk email dan dokumen.
Di SaaS, penyedia mengurus infrastruktur, server, dan update aplikasinya.
Tanggung jawab customer paling besar di on-premises, lalu IaaS, lalu PaaS, dan paling kecil di SaaS.
Serverless berarti customer tidak mengelola server: penyedia menjalankan dan menskalakan kodenya, dan kode berjalan saat dipicu event.
Azure Functions adalah layanan serverless untuk menjalankan kode yang dipicu event, misalnya request HTTP, file baru, atau timer.

Di plan serverless Azure Functions, yaitu Flex Consumption (yang direkomendasikan untuk app baru) dan Consumption (versi lama), customer membayar saat function berjalan: jumlah eksekusi dan memori yang dipakai selama kode berjalan.
Azure Functions menambah dan mengurangi instance secara otomatis mengikuti jumlah event yang masuk.
Contoh pemakaian Azure Functions: memproses file yang baru di-upload dan menjalankan tugas terjadwal dengan timer.
Serverless bukan jenis layanan cloud keempat: shared responsibility model Microsoft hanya mengenal tiga jenis layanan cloud, yaitu IaaS, PaaS, dan SaaS, dan Azure Functions digolongkan sebagai PaaS.
